instruction: A cinematic portrait photograph in a close-up shot at eye-level, set indoors against a plain grey wall. On the right, in the foreground, the woman in the white shirt (R1) stands facing forward with her head tilted slightly, looking directly at the camera with a calm, neutral expression. On the left, in the background, the woman in the grey shirt (R2) stands close behind, resting her head against the other woman's shoulder and looking towards the camera with a soft, serious gaze. The woman in the grey shirt (R2) rests her right hand gently on the front of the woman in the white shirt's (R1) left shoulder. Strong, direct sunlight streams from the upper right, casting a sharp shadow across the right side of the woman in the white shirt's (R1) face and illuminating the left side of the woman in the grey shirt's (R2) face.
